findings.what:
FILL RULES for the template: a case table (a)-(f) that maps the 47/49 codes to BASE, DIV stop rule and W2a; a conditional W2b text, because 48 (CI) is unread at send time; V_pub, T_last and the E10 threshold formulas; answer parsing. FILL RULES (main session; all from CONTEXT READ TABLE v3 (1)/(5), R21-A3 (b)/(c), W2 TABLE v4, W4 AMEND 2, R21-A9):
- Send ONE message at the first poll header where 47 AND 49 are terminal (expected ~08:15-08:50Z); hard latest 09:30Z even if 49 is PENDING. 48 is never waited for.
- D47/D49 = display; C*_RU from the count rule (S0 = newest download with count 48, then 49; fresh manual download within ~10 min of each terminal header; log k):
  '+' -> 'лучше cap 6 (дисплей {D} / подъём: обогнали {N} команд)'; '0' -> 'не лучше cap 6'; '?' -> 'не читается (дисплей равен, подъём не виден)'; '-' -> 'хуже cap 6'; ERROR -> 'ошибка на {L} ч' (one unchanged resubmit only if L < 10 h and a W2 slot would otherwise stay empty).
- '0' only if exp70g still holds our unrounded best at that S0; after an UP of 47, a 0.956 for 49 is '?'. k = 0 -> '?'.
- BASE_RU = strictly highest display among COMPLETE cap-family files; tie -> the file with the attributable UP; else exp70g > exp78a > exp78b > exp80a > exp70q.
- DIV_RU / W2A_RU by case:
  (a) 47 '+' and D47 >= D49 -> DIV 'идём дальше: cap 24 + fc2 (S3)'; W2A 'exp80a = K2 + cap 24 + frame cap 2'.
  (b) 49 '+' and 47 not '+' -> DIV 'стоп на cap 8 (S2)'; W2A 'exp81 = exp70g + N2 (проба новой вторички)'.
  (c) both '-' or '0' -> DIV 'закрыто, база exp70g (S1)'; W2A 'exp81'.
  (d) any '?' without a '+' -> DIV 'шага нет (S4)'; W2A 'exp81'.
  (e) both '+' with D49 > D47 -> BASE exp78a; DIV 'стоп на cap 8'; W2A 'exp81'.
  (f) 49 PENDING at send time -> W2A 'решится после чтения 49 (~08:45Z): cap 24 + fc2, если cap 12 «+» и не ниже cap 8; иначе exp81'.
- W2B_RU (48 unread at send time; state it conditionally): 'после чтения 48 (~10:40Z): если CI «+» -> {exp83a при базе cap 12 | exp83b при базе cap 8 | при базе exp70g слот уходит на вечер (<= 23:30Z) под стек «+»-рычагов}; иначе {exp81, если W2a взял exp80a | стек база + CI, если CI не читается и база cap 8/12 | вечерний стек или пусто}'. CI-RAN GATE: dL = L_hi(48) - L_hi(47) <= 0.5 h -> CI did not run -> '?' (post-deadline list, never resubmitted).
- V_PUB = R20-A9 (a)/R21-A9 (i): 'exp70g (cap 6), 0.956' unless a non-CI non-SEC cap file is strictly higher or equal with an attributable UP; L_hi <= 9.0 h; gate did NOT fire.
- T_LAST = 18:30Z - (L_ref + 0.25 h), L_ref = the largest L_hi of our 3 newest COMPLETE K2-like refs (with 7.81 h: ~10:25Z). CI: quote the stricter 07:30Z (W4 AMEND 2 (5)), not 08:00Z.
- E10_THR = our best display + 0.001 (now 0.957; 0.958 if 47/49 displays 0.957).
- Parse answers per R16-A1 (5): an answer counts only for the question it names; a bare 'ок/да' is an acknowledgement -> defaults stand, reply once with the numbered checklist, no second nag. Echo the parsed answer in one CONTEXT line.

findings.what: The honest arithmetic behind question 1 (lift the 02:00Z cap), default NO. 29 Sep has 5 slots, and W4 uses <= 4 planned files plus 1 held for E10. After 02:00Z only a non-CI twin of a '+' FULL, one DIV step under S3, or an E10 copy is allowed, so the lift buys <= 2 extra files, submitted after the W4 reads (~07:40-09:30Z) and read by ~18:15Z. P(one of them raises V_pub's display) ~0.15-0.35 (this week: 1 clear step, 45, in ~8 knob probes 39-46). The bronze spread among cap-family F1s paired with #37 is <= ~0.06 (R21-A9 (iii)), so the expected medal value is <= ~0.02 bronze, and the private value is ~0 because of winner's curse. Cost: less time to review the finals before the ~19:00Z FINALS READ. A late or PENDING file is harmless, because a non-COMPLETE file is never a final. So the default stays NO. The user's 19:10Z wish to 'try all variants first' is the only argument for YES, and the brief says so neutrally.
